description_en: Queries the resources associated with an inspection item
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq list-instance-inspection-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id rmq-cn-example --template-code rmq.consumer-health --api-version 2022-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstanceInspectionResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the resource belongs. Wildcards are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 所属实例 ID；不允许通配符
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the inspection item
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en: Optional. If specified, only the historical resource snapshot for the task is queried. If the snapshot is not generated, a 409 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 选填；指定后仅查询该次历史资源快照，快照未形成返回 409
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous request. Do not specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的游标；首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

data.description_en: The resources on the current page. If a task ID is specified, historical snapshots are returned
data.description_zh: 本页资源；带 taskId 时为历史快照

name.description_en: The optional display name of the resource

result.description_en: The inspection result. Valid values: info and risk. This parameter is empty if the inspection is not completed or fails
result.description_zh: 巡检结论：info、risk；未完成或执行失败时为空
result.title_en: 巡检结论：info、risk；未完成或执行失败时为空
result.title_zh: 巡检结论：info、risk；未完成或执行失败时为空

summary.description_en: The summary of the inspection result for the resource. This parameter may not be returned for the current resource list
summary.description_zh: 该次巡检对该资源的结论摘要；当前资源清单可不返回
summary.title_en: 该次巡检对该资源的结论摘要；当前资源清单可不返回
summary.title_zh: 该次巡检对该资源的结论摘要；当前资源清单可不返回

data.title_en: 本页资源；带 taskId 时为历史快照
data.title_zh: 本页资源；带 taskId 时为历史快照

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page for the current request. This value is not the actual number of returned entries
maxResults.description_zh: 本次生效的单页上限，不是实际返回条数
maxResults.title_en: 本次生效的单页上限，不是实际返回条数
maxResults.title_zh: 本次生效的单页上限，不是实际返回条数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is empty if the current page is the last page
